row_identity_rule: IDs are member basename plus exact existing heading anchor. Digests bind source bytes; lines are diagnostics. A heading locator alone asserts neither irreducibility nor complete semantic ownership.

field_semantics.consumers: Stable determination IDs, inverse of the authored dependencies list; exact owner is recovered from the referenced row.
field_semantics.empty_fields: An empty extraction is not proof of no source duty, exception or result map.
field_semantics.representation_kind: constraint, definition_data, consumer_binding or non_deciding_locator; this partitions work, not independent law counts. Definition bodies can contain embedded constraints, named in their remaining work.

judgment: Confirms the author-review count, not that 389 independent deciding rules are broken or need a downstream consumer. Actual rule consumers or a supported absence need semantic assessment; the source explicitly denies that an empty extraction proves absence.
